exceptions.justification: Pure fragment encoding of an immutable finite UTF-8 JSON token, not polling or an external wait. offset starts at zero and advances by min(available - len(pending), len(raw) - offset); pending is strictly below available on entry, and a full fragment yields then clears pending before the next iteration. Nonpositive available fails closed. allocation derives the actual 2 MiB per-record envelope including ordinal; no total snapshot byte/time cap is implied. The real large FleetSnapshot roundtrip checks every record bound and original full document, and the PostgreSQL slow-ASGI proof checks SQL release and threadpool encoding. Each emitted fragment yields to the transport; this classification does not claim CPU preemption or physical-worker coverage.
